nodes.summary: A complex number $x$ is admissible when $j + 1 + x \ne 0$ for every natural number $j$, that is, when $x$ is not one of $-1, -2, -3, \dots$.
nodes.title: Admissible parameters for the power-difference series

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $1 \le k \le n - 1$, the point $x = -k/n$ is admissible, that is, $j + 1 + x \neq 0$ for every natural number $j$.
nodes.title: The points $-k/n$ are admissible

nodes.summary: The point $x = 0$ is admissible: $j + 1 + x \neq 0$ for every natural number $j$.
nodes.title: Zero is admissible

nodes.summary: Admissibility in the corollary of Ramanujan's Entry 10 is admissibility for the power-difference series: $x$ is not one of $-1, -2, -3, \dots$.

nodes.summary: For a function $\varphi : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$, a natural number $n$ and $r \in \mathbb{C}$, the left side of the corollary to Entry 10 is $\sum_{k=1}^{n-1} \varphi(r, -k/n)$, the empty sum $0$ when $n \le 1$. In Berndt's notation, $\varphi(r, x)$ is written $\varphi_r(x)$.
nodes.title: Left side of the corollary to Entry 10

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and $r \in \mathbb{C}$, the right side of the corollary to Entry 10 is $(n - n^{-r})\,\zeta(-r)$, where $n^{-r}$ is the principal complex power and $\zeta$ is the Riemann zeta function.
nodes.title: Right side of the corollary to Entry 10

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$ and $x \in \mathbb{C}$, $P_r(x) = \frac{B_{r+1}(x + 1) - B_{r+1}(1)}{r + 1}$, where $B_{r+1}$ is the Bernoulli polynomial of degree $r + 1$.

nodes.summary: The open interval $(-1, 0)$ of real numbers, that is, the set of real $x$ with $-1 < x < 0$.
nodes.title: Arguments of Berndt's $\varphi_r(x)$

nodes.summary: Let $r$ be a positive integer and $-1 < x < 0$. Then $\varphi_r(x) = \zeta(-r) - \zeta(-r, x + 1)$, where $\zeta$ is the Riemann zeta function and $\zeta(s, a)$ the Hurwitz zeta function, equals $P_r(x) = \frac{B_{r+1}(x + 1) - B_{r+1}(1)}{r + 1}$, where $B_{r+1}$ is the Bernoulli polynomial of degree $r + 1$.
nodes.title: Berndt's $\varphi_r$ as a Bernoulli-polynomial difference for positive integer $r$

nodes.summary: For a complex number $r$ and a real number $x$ with $-1 < x < 0$, $\varphi_r(x) = \zeta(-r) - \zeta(-r, x + 1)$, where $\zeta$ is the Riemann zeta function and $\zeta(s, a)$ is the Hurwitz zeta function, both analytically continued in $s$. At $r = -1$, where both have a pole, $\zeta(1)$ and $\zeta(1, x + 1)$ denote the finite values that the formal definitions assign at the pole.
nodes.title: Berndt's function $\varphi_r(x)$ on $(-1, 0)$

nodes.summary: For complex numbers $r$ and $x$, $\varphi_r(x) = \sum_{j \ge 0} \bigl((j + 1)^r - (j + 1 + x)^r\bigr)$ (principal powers), where the sum is taken to be $0$ when the series is not summable.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
